Messages.Author: thiagotargino
Messages.Body:
Does the damage inflicted by Alejandro Aguirre's ability against an infernal vampire is aggravated while he has a True Faith attached?

True Faith says "In combat", but in this case it is a combat he is not involved in.

Flip a coin. Thank you.

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body: Well we might need an official ruling but at first glance I’d say yes, damage is aggravated: it’s in combat, it’s damage he inflicts.
